subject: Stalewood RFP: control synthesis + telemetry & KMS artifact dependency list
messages:
From: Anita Rao <anita.ra@stalewood.com>
To: kimberly.park@redwood.com
Cc: Procurement <procurement@stalewood.com>, security@stalewood.com
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Stalewood RFP: control synthesis + telemetry & KMS artifact dependency list

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the quick turnaround on the RFP intake. As we prepare the SIG and ISO appendices for our procurement packet, we have a couple of follow-up clarifications that are blocking final scoring: 

1) Telemetry & retention: you have indicated "application telemetry" is available for 90 days in the RFP. We need sample telemetry exports (recent 7 days) with schema and retention policy, plus an explanation of what is and isn't logged (e.g., request headers, IPs, prompt/response metadata, KV cache events).

2) KMS / key provenance: the questionnaire asks for proof that customer key material (or customer-managed keys) can be rotated and that lineage/provenance is retained in audit logs. We need a concise mapping to SIG section 3.x and ISO clause references, and any evidence artifacts you can share (key rotation logs, sample audit lines).

3) Control crosswalk: please map your SOC 2 controls to the SIG matrix for the sections we highlighted (confidentiality, change control, incident response). A single spreadsheet with clear artifact pointers is preferred.

We know some artifacts will be redacted; that's OK — just include a short explanation of redaction rules. Our S&T and procurement teams are on a tight deadline (decision window closes 2027-05-11). Can you confirm you can deliver an evidence packet and short call this week?

Regards,
Anita Rao
Head of Vendor Assurance
Stalewood Financial

---
Attachment: (none)
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Anita Rao <anita.ra@stalewood.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, security@stalewood.com
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Stalewood RFP: control synthesis + telemetry & KMS artifact dependency list

Hi Anita — thanks for the clear list. We can produce a compact evidence packet and a 30-minute technical walkthrough this week. High-level plan: 

- Deliver a control crosswalk (SOC 2 -> SIG -> ISO) with artifact pointers (spreadsheet).
- Provide a 7-day telemetry sample (redacted) and retention policy summary.
- Provide KMS rotation proof points and a short provenance summary with sample audit lines.

I'm attaching an initial crosswalk (redwood_control_crosswalk_v1.pdf) and a short KMS provenance explainer (kms-provenance-summary.txt). We'll follow up with the telemetry export and the signed artifact bundle.

Can you do Thursday 2027-05-06 at 10:00 AM ET for the walkthrough? If that doesn't work, propose a window and we'll adapt. Also, please mark which SIG sections you need prioritized — we can triage the artifacts accordingly.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Director, Enterprise Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

---
Attachments: redwood_control_crosswalk_v1.pdf (PDF, 320KB), kms-provenance-summary.txt (text, 4KB)
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 11:15:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Stalewood RFP — artifact owners and redaction guidance

Jordan / Karthik — looping you in to coordinate the artifact delivery for Stalewood. Anita asked for prioritized SIG sections (confidentiality, change control, incident response), plus telemetry and KMS provenance. Proposed split: 

- Jordan: assemble a 7-day telemetry export (jsonl), include schema and a short README with retention rules and redaction notes. Redact any raw user prompt text — replace with prompt-hash and show token-size metadata. Add a sample of KV cache event logs that show cache hits/misses.

- Karthik: produce KMS artefacts (rotation event sample, audit-line extracts, key lineage diagram) and confirm whether we can produce customer-managed key screenshots for Private deployments. Provide mapping to SIG 3.x items.

Timeline: deliver drafts by end of day Tue 2027-05-04 so we can package and send Wed morning. 

Call is tentatively Thursday 10am ET. If either of you needs more time, flag now.

Thanks,
Kim
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 15:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Internal: Stalewood RFP — artifact owners and redaction guidance

Kim — attaching the telemetry export and runbook per your ask. Notes: 

- telemetry-sample-7days.jsonl (attached) is a 7-day rollup with IPs redacted and prompt contents replaced by prompt_hash. Fields included: event_time, route, model_id, latency_ms, token_count, prompt_hash, kv_cache_hit (true/false), retention_bucket.
- obs-runbook.pdf contains the retention table and the retention enforcement job snippet.

I included an abbreviated README at the top of the jsonl file that explains the redaction pattern and how to map prompt_hash back to evaluation-only artefacts if SOW permits. We scoped the export to production telemetry for the hosted API only (Dedicated/Private artifacts would require separate access).

Let me know if we should add an example of prefix cache eviction events — I can include two lines showing a cache-eviction event id and timestamp.

Jordan
Senior Security Engineer
Redwood Inference

---

Deliverables (attached / in Drive):
- redwood_control_crosswalk_v1.pdf — SOC 2 -> SIG -> ISO mapping with artifact pointers.

Next steps: 
- Confirm Thursday 2027-05-06 10:00 AM ET for the 30-minute technical walkthrough (I invited Jordan and Karthik).
- Tell us which SIG questions you want us to prioritize for unredacted evidence under an NDA/controlled exchange.

Related links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2bStalewoodEvidence (full bundle), HubSpot ticket: TS-8891 (https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/ticket/TS-8891).

If there are any procurement-specific formatting requirements for the evidence packet, let me know and we'll adapt the files accordingly.

Best,
Kimberly Park
